units.source_text: 警察举起右手拿着的棍子（这个国家的警察不佩剑，常用的是水松木制棍子），对着那只河童喊了声：“喂！”

en.t: The policeman raised the club he was holding in his right hand (in that country policemen do not carry swords, but usually use clubs made of mizumatsu wood) and shouted at the kappa, "Hey!"

units.source_text: 我想那只河童可能会逃跑。

en.t: I thought the kappa might run away.

units.source_text: 意外的是他却沉着地走到警察跟前，双臂交叉，傲慢地看着着我和警察的脸。

en.t: To my surprise, he calmly walked up to the policeman, folded his arms, and looked arrogantly at both my face and the policeman's.
